Converts the scan points of a FARO terrestrial laser scanner, exported as xyz text by the SCENE software, to a las file.

**Toolbox folder:** Lesto › utilities<br>
**Status:** Experimental<br>
**Keywords:** las, tls, convert<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.lesto.modules.utilities.LasFromFaroTlsXyz`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inFile` | file |  |  | The xyz file to convert, with the columns row, column, x and y from the scanner, elevation, red, green and blue. |
| `pLongitude` | Double |  |  | The easting of the scanner in the projected reference system of the output, added to the x of the points. |
| `pLatitude` | Double |  |  | The northing of the scanner in the projected reference system of the output, added to the y of the points. |
| `pMaxDistance` | Double | m |  | The maximum horizontal distance from the scanner: the farther points are left out. |
| `pCode` | CRS code |  |  | The code defining the data coordinate reference system. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outLas` | output file |  | The converted las output file. |
